newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan Yangming to set up Japan unit.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan Yangming to set up Japan unit.

text.p: Taiwan's Yangming Marine Corp said on Thursday it would operate a wholly-owned unit in Japan from January to strengthen services in that country.
Yangming will terminate relations with Japanese agent Manwa Co Ltd on December 31 and Yangming Marine (Japan) Co Ltd will start operation on January 1, the company said in a statement.
"We'll strengthen our networked facilities and human power in Japan ... and expect to speedily upgrade our service standards there," the statement said.
Yangming had estimated its alliances with other shipping firms should help save US$39 million in operating costs in 1997 and that the savings would almost double in 1998.
In January 1996, an alliance between Yangming and Japan's Kawasaki Kisen Kaisha started operations.
The partners offer joint services in their Asia-North Europe container operations and a separate cross-space charter service in trans-Pacific trade.
Yangming, one of Taiwan's top shipping firms, was privatised in February after an offer of 110 million shares, which reduced the government's stake in the firm to 48 percent from 56.5 percent.
